label: exploratory
rule: Holm step-down over these 3 one-sided superiority comparisons at familywise alpha 0.05; seed-pair reading (each arm seed paired with each comparator seed, speakers kept); EMA pooled FULL dev. A comparison PASSES iff its Holm-adjusted one-sided upper bound < 0 and its p <= its Holm level. Arm 17's left_context=256 is called better iff at least one chunk passes; per-chunk results reported regardless.
caveat: arm 17 was picked for replication from its single-seed full-dev result (Holm family 16/17/18 at chunk 4, p 0.071); the utterance sample is the same, only the training seed is new.
file_names: arm 17-r's files as trainer-lane names them; the family is fixed by arm, chunk, kind, comparator and population, not by file name
